fields.title: File
fields.placeholder: Upload file to send to Box

fields.title: Email Message
fields.placeholder: Custom message in the signing email

fields.title: Destination Folder ID
fields.placeholder: Box folder ID for signed documents

fields.title: Audio/Video File
fields.placeholder: Upload an audio or video file

fields.title: Audio/Video URL
fields.placeholder: Or enter publicly accessible audio/video URL

fields.title: Personal Access Token
fields.placeholder: Enter your GitLab Personal Access Token

fields.title: Project ID
fields.placeholder: Enter project ID or path (e.g., username/project)

fields.title: From
fields.placeholder: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to compare from

fields.title: To
fields.placeholder: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to compare to

fields.title: Tag Name
fields.placeholder: Enter the Git tag for the release (e.g., v1.0.0)

fields.title: Released At
fields.placeholder: ISO 8601 date for an upcoming or historical release (optional)

fields.title: Since
fields.placeholder: Only commits after this ISO 8601 date (optional)

fields.title: Until
fields.placeholder: Only commits before this ISO 8601 date (optional)

fields.title: Author
fields.placeholder: Filter commits by author name or email (optional)

fields.title: Last Commit ID
fields.placeholder: Fail if the file changed since this commit SHA (optional)

fields.title: Tag Message
fields.placeholder: Annotation message when creating a new tag (optional)

fields.title: Start Branch
fields.placeholder: Base branch to create the target branch from, if missing (optional)

fields.title: From Project ID
fields.placeholder: Project to compare from, for cross-fork comparisons (optional)

fields.title: Results Per Page
fields.placeholder: Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 100)

fields.title: Project / Group ID
fields.placeholder: Enter project or group ID or path (e.g., mygroup/myproject)

fields.title: Username
fields.placeholder: Username to add instead of a user ID

fields.title: Expires At
fields.placeholder: YYYY-MM-DD (optional) - access is revoked on this date

fields.title: Filter
fields.placeholder: Filter members by name/username, invitations by exact email, or branches by name

fields.title: Invite Source
fields.placeholder: Identifier recorded as the source of the invitation (optional)

fields.title: User IDs
fields.placeholder: Comma-separated user IDs to filter to (optional)

fields.title: Search
fields.placeholder: Name, username, or email to search for

fields.title: SAML Group Name
fields.placeholder: Name of the SAML group as sent by the identity provider

fields.title: SAML Provider
fields.placeholder: Provider name (required when multiple links share a group name)

fields.title: Password
fields.placeholder: Password (omit and enable Send Reset Link instead)

fields.title: Status
fields.placeholder: Enter status name (e.g., custom workspace status label)

fields.title: Search Query
fields.placeholder: Enter search query to find relevant memories

fields.title: API Key
fields.placeholder: Enter your Obsidian Local REST API key

fields.title: Target
fields.placeholder: Heading text, block ID, or frontmatter field

fields.title: Increment
fields.placeholder: Amount to increment by (negative to decrement)

fields.title: Preview Text
fields.placeholder: Shown in the inbox before opening

fields.title: Block Kit Blocks
fields.placeholder: JSON array of Block Kit blocks

fields.title: Status Text
fields.placeholder: e.g., Working on it… (leave empty to clear)

fields.title: Loading Messages
fields.placeholder: Optional JSON array of phrases to animate (max 10)

fields.title: Thread Title
fields.placeholder: Title to display for the assistant thread

fields.title: New Message Text
fields.placeholder: Enter new message text (supports Slack mrkdwn)

fields.title: Emoji Name
fields.placeholder: Emoji name without colons (e.g., thumbsup, heart, eyes)

fields.title: View ID
fields.placeholder: Unique view identifier (either View ID or External ID required)

fields.title: View Hash
fields.placeholder: View state hash for race condition protection

fields.title: User
fields.placeholder: Select user to publish Home tab to

fields.title: View Payload
fields.placeholder: JSON view payload with type, title, and blocks

fields.title: Action Event ID
fields.placeholder: Hiring event ID that enables onboarding
